metric_definitions.slot_denominator_D_tK: min(K,|eligible cohort_C_t|), common for every arm
metric_definitions.primary_precision_at_K: TP_tK/D_tK. A known v2 underfill contributes unused cash slots and no true positives. Separately report conditional precision TP/n_selected; conditional precision is not the promotion comparator.
metric_definitions.event_capture: TP_tK/P_t, where_P_t is the number of positive labels in cohort_C_t. Sessions with_P_t=0 are reported separately and excluded from capture-difference tests, identically for every arm.
metric_definitions.censored_labels: Seal topK atcutoff andneverrefill. Unresolvedpicks remain in the fixedD_tKdenominator, withunknowncount andidentificationbounds[knownTP/D,(knownTP+unknownpicks)/D]. They are not true negatives. Censoring/unknownpositive-denominator prevents promotion unless qualifiedevidence resolvesit; never removeunknowns to improveprecision or choose a favorable subset.
metric_definitions.lift: Slot_precision/(P_t/|C_t|); undefined when_P_t=0. Report descriptively with denominators, never a separate hidden promotion test.
metric_definitions.net_returns: Use the sealed control map for the complete cohort, the cash/whole-share/fee/impact/5K-cap contract in portfolio, and the fixed per-session paired slot-excess mean in statistical_aggregation.net. Retain nonfill cash, unmatched rows and censored economics. Portfolio net return/drawdown are separately defined by the actual NAV ledger; no hidden aggregate choice.
metric_definitions.net_costs: Exactly portfolio.fees and portfolio.impact.300/600 round-trip bps split equally per side in modeled executable prices, plus the frozen per-order commission. Cross the supported ask/bid once; no second spread or duplicate impact debit.

statistical_aggregation.precision: For each K/label/baseline, d_t=(TP_main,t/D_tK)-(TP_baseline,t/D_tK). The estimand is the arithmetic MEAN of these per-session differences over the shared set with |C_t|>0 and qualified labels. Each session gets weight1, independent of cohort size. It is not pooled sum(TP)/sum(D). Empty-C sessions remain logged and contribute no undefined precision.
statistical_aggregation.capture: For each K/label/baseline, e_t=(TP_main,t/P_t)-(TP_baseline,t/P_t). The estimand is the arithmetic MEAN of per-session differences over the common qualified sessions with P_t>0. P_t=0 sessions are retained/counted but excluded identically for every arm. It is not a pooled ratio.
statistical_aggregation.bootstrap: Use the same native arch.bootstrap.CircularBlockBootstrap index vector for every paired arm/label/mask/metric in the complete fixed49999drawstream on the ordered scored-session grid. Recompute each declared equal-weight pairedmean and robustness transform over its sampled commonvalidoccurrences; multiplicity follows the native index vector. If the original statement is insufficient or ANY required draw statistic is undefined/nonfinite/all-invalid/insufficient after its transform, record its drawposition/reason/count and mark thatstatementINSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE withlower_bound=null. Complete the fixed shared stream; neverdelete/retry/regenerate a draw, substitutezero/-infinity, use nanquantile, or calculate from survivingdraws. Valid draws use the fixed native linearquantile rule in uncertainty_and_multiplicity. Preserve the126family and36promotionbounds; no default archCI/StepM/SPA/MCS. First-fiveboundarysessions are not scored/addedback; empty-Cchronologicalsessions stay. Nativeprimitive evidence is separate; no study statistic computed.
statistical_aggregation.net: For each main selected slot use its sealed control and each leg's realized net lot PnL divided by its declared pre-entry allocation budget, including whole-share residual cash. A supported nonfill is zero exposure/zero lot PnL, not a missing exit. Unused main selection slots are actual cash with zero difference. Let x_t be the mean of these paired slot excess returns over the common D_tK slots. The net-return estimand is the arithmetic mean of x_t across scored decision sessions with defined paired economics; neither pooling fills nor weighting sessions by fill count is allowed. Missing selected controls/entitlements/exits remain missing and cannot be set to zero, dropped to obtain a positive full-slot bound or rematched. Conditional diagnostics may show counts, but undefined full-slot economics blocks its acceptance.
statistical_aggregation.portfolio_distinction: The session excess-return comparison concerns entry-cohort slot quality; the net-total-return/drawdown gate separately uses the actual cash-constrained portfolio NAV path below. Neither statistic substitutes for the other.
